effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[Your Turn] When this Digimon checks your opponent's security stack, if you have 3 or more security cards, gain 1 memory. If you have 2 or fewer, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
